title: llm_provider_capability_registry
description: Capability registry over the EXISTING _llm_client.PROVIDERS lanes (ollama/openrouter/openwebui/nvidia/omniroute). One entry per generation LANE: what models it serves, its context/output ceiling, structured-output/json/batch/caching support, rate/token/concurrency limits, cost, the data classes it is allowed to see, timeout, and status. Consumed by scripts/llm_capability_router.py (job-type -> lane routing) and scripts/model_lane_bakeoff.py. This registry is DATA (rpm/tpm/cost/data-class policy that lives nowhere else); model ids + endpoints are mirrored from scripts/_config.py and scripts/_llm_client.PROVIDERS and are drift-gated at runtime by the router self-test (every entry's provider_id must be a key of _llm_client.PROVIDERS; every referenced model must appear in its lane's models[]). serves_truth=false at this layer.

data_classes.description: Ordered data-sensitivity vocabulary, least->most sensitive. A lane may only see a data class listed in its allowed_data_classes; sensitive/restricted route LOCAL-first.

providers.description: Map of unique lane id -> capability entry. Two entries may share a provider_id (e.g. Ollama Cloud vs local) but each lane id is unique.

provider_id.$comment: MUST be a key of scripts/_llm_client.PROVIDERS (enforced at runtime by the router self-test; this enum is the static mirror).
